bagPolicy.summary: The venue allows small nonclear bags up to 4 × 6 inches, clear bags up to 12 × 12 inches and one-gallon clear storage bags. Backpacks, duffel bags and oversize purses are prohibited; purses are searched.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Stack garage directly behind the venue has limited concert parking; its entrance is off 2700 Commerce Street. Event pages may offer prepaid spaces.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The FAQ suggests Uber and Lyft for travel to the venue but does not designate a specific pickup or drop-off curb.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Most Bomb Factory shows have food options, and the venue sells beer, wine, liquor and nonalcoholic drinks. Its security policy permits outside food but prohibits outside drinks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Limited ADA spaces are first come, first served and accommodate the guest plus one companion. Arrive early and ask staff for assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Bomb Factory prohibits leaving and re-entering during a show.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect will-call tickets on the show day at the box office window off Canton Street near Henry Street, beside the front entrances. The box office opens about 30 minutes before doors.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The entrance is on Canton Street between Henry and Crowdus. Guests pass a metal detector and must show their ticket in the AXS app; screenshots do not work. Check the event listing for door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
